# Dashboard

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:gen` from the code. Do not edit: `pnpm test` fails when it is stale. -->

Each area of `app/src`, what it may import and why, and its number of files. The rule is `MAY_IMPORT` in `daemon/scripts/lib/dashboard-layout.ts`, which `daemon/test/architecture/dashboard-layout.test.ts` enforces; `pages/` and `components/layout/` combine the contexts, and `components/ui/` holds the pieces they share.

The layers `lib/` (pure helpers, shared ones in `lib/shared/`), `composables/` (`useX` functions, shared ones in `composables/shared/`), `components/` (Vue components, shared ones in `components/ui/`) each have a folder per context: `work/`, `runs/`, `landing/`, `repos/`, `operations/`, `insights/`. A context may have a sub-folder where it has the same one in every layer that needs it (`work/queue/`, `work/files/`).

| Area                      | May import                                                                                               | Why                                                                                                                                       | Files |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `api/`                    | nothing                                                                                                  | api/ is the base: types, calls and query options                                                                                          | 9     |
| `platform/`               | `lib/shared/`                                                                                            | platform/ is the Tauri shell, build commit and theme                                                                                      | 3     |
| `router.ts`               | `api/`, `lib/shared/`, `pages/`, `components/layout/`                                                    | the router names each route's page (and the tray window), and nothing below the pages imports it                                          | 1     |
| `lib/shared/`             | `api/`                                                                                                   | lib/shared/ is shared by every context, so it imports none of them in its layer                                                           | 11    |
| `lib/work/`               | `lib/shared/`, `lib/runs/`, `lib/landing/`, `api/`                                                       | lib/work/ may import runs and landing: the queue and the task overview show a run's summary, a pull request and the merge buttons         | 17    |
| `lib/runs/`               | `lib/shared/`, `api/`                                                                                    | a context imports no other context                                                                                                        | 10    |
| `lib/landing/`            | `lib/shared/`, `api/`                                                                                    | a context imports no other context                                                                                                        | 1     |
| `lib/operations/`         | `lib/shared/`, `lib/runs/`, `lib/landing/`, `api/`                                                       | lib/operations/ may import runs and landing: the activity pill words a run, a sync and a merge request the way the task rows do           | 2     |
| `lib/insights/`           | `lib/shared/`, `api/`                                                                                    | a context imports no other context                                                                                                        | 1     |
